projects.name: Analytics Dashboard
projects.description:
A new analytics dashboard project encompassing three core data domains: (1) data processing from customer CSV files, (2) log analysis from application logs, and (3) visualization components. The project will ingest, transform, and analyze customer and log data, then present insights through an interactive dashboard. Structured into milestones with manageable, low-complexity tasks.

Tags: analytics, dashboard, data-processing, log-analysis, visualization

tasks.name: Milestone 1: Project Setup & Architecture
tasks.details: Establish the foundation for the analytics dashboard: define architecture, set up repositories and environments, choose the data stack, and establish data schemas and conventions. This milestone unblocks all data and visualization work.

tasks.name: Milestone 2: Customer CSV Data Processing
tasks.details: Build the pipeline that ingests, validates, cleans, and transforms customer CSV files into analytics-ready datasets. Covers ingestion, schema validation, cleaning, transformation, and loading into the analytics store.

tasks.name: Milestone 3: Application Log Analysis
tasks.details: Build the pipeline that ingests and parses application logs, extracts structured events, computes metrics (errors, latency, usage), and stores aggregated results for visualization.

tasks.name: Milestone 4: Visualization Components & Dashboard Integration
tasks.details: Design and build reusable visualization components, assemble the dashboard layout, wire components to processed data, and add interactivity, filtering, and final QA.

tasks.name: Define system architecture and data flow
tasks.details: Document the end-to-end architecture: data sources (customer CSV, app logs), ingestion, processing, storage, and dashboard layers. Produce an architecture diagram and data-flow description.

tasks.name: Set up repository and development environment
tasks.details: Initialize the code repository, branching strategy, CI skeleton, and local dev environment (runtime, package manager, linting, formatting).

tasks.name: Select data stack and dependencies
tasks.details: Evaluate and select the processing framework, storage/analytics store, and visualization library. Document rationale and pin dependency versions.

tasks.name: Define data schemas and naming conventions
tasks.details: Specify canonical schemas for customer records and log events, plus naming, typing, and timestamp conventions used across pipelines and the dashboard.

tasks.name: Build CSV ingestion module
tasks.details: Implement file discovery and reading of customer CSV files, including encoding detection, delimiter handling, and chunked reads for large files.

tasks.name: Implement CSV schema validation
tasks.details: Validate incoming CSV files against the canonical customer schema: required columns, data types, and value constraints. Emit clear validation errors and a reject/quarantine path.

tasks.name: Implement data cleaning and normalization
tasks.details: Handle missing values, deduplication, whitespace trimming, date/currency normalization, and type coercion for customer records.

tasks.name: Implement customer data transformations
tasks.details: Derive analytics fields (e.g., customer segments, lifetime value inputs, aggregates) and produce the transformed customer dataset.

tasks.name: Load customer data into analytics store
tasks.details: Write transformed customer data into the analytics store with idempotent upserts, partitioning, and load logging.

tasks.name: Build log ingestion module
tasks.details: Implement collection and reading of application log files, including rotation handling, file tailing, and batching for downstream parsing.

tasks.name: Implement log format parsing
tasks.details: Parse supported log formats (e.g., JSON, plaintext) into structured records, handling malformed lines gracefully with error capture.

tasks.name: Extract structured log events
tasks.details: Normalize parsed logs into structured events: timestamp, level, service, message, request ID, and latency fields, aligned to the canonical log schema.

tasks.name: Compute log metrics and aggregations
tasks.details: Calculate error rates, request counts, latency percentiles, and time-bucketed usage metrics from structured log events.

tasks.name: Store aggregated log results
tasks.details: Persist structured events and aggregated metrics into the analytics store with partitioning by time and service, plus load logging.

tasks.name: Design visualization component library
tasks.details: Define the reusable component set (KPI cards, line/bar charts, tables, filters) with props, theming, and accessibility guidelines.

tasks.name: Build chart and KPI components
tasks.details: Implement the individual chart and KPI components from the library design, including loading and empty states.

tasks.name: Assemble dashboard layout
tasks.details: Compose the dashboard page layout with sections for customer analytics and log analytics, using a responsive grid.

tasks.name: Wire dashboard components to data
tasks.details: Connect visualization components to the analytics store/API, implement data fetching, caching, and error handling.

tasks.name: Add interactivity and filters
tasks.details: Implement date-range selection, service/customer filters, and cross-component interactions (drill-downs, tooltips).

tasks.name: Dashboard QA and testing
tasks.details: Run end-to-end tests, validate data accuracy against source, check responsiveness and accessibility, and fix defects.
